sourceStatement: Identifiers, names and cardinalities come from the semantic model column of table 1.1 of the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension; the structure was cross-checked against the KoSIT XRechnung semantic-model XSD. BG-DEX-01 hangs under BG-25 of model/en16931/2017.json, which is the only parent identifier not defined in this file. The groups of the SUB INVOICE LINE tree carry ordinary EN 16931-1 business terms one level deeper; those terms are listed per group in reusesTerms instead of being repeated as terms of this registry.

terms.name: SUB INVOICE LINE
terms.description: Group carrying one subordinate invoice line beneath an invoice line.
notes: Identifier, name and cardinality are taken from the semantic model column of the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.

In the KoSIT visualization XSD this element is typed xr:INVOICE_LINEType, i.e. it recurses into INVOICE LINE; the dedicated xr:SUB_INVOICE_* types exist in the schema but are unreachable from the root.

terms.name: SUB INVOICE LINE ITEM INFORMATION
terms.description: Group describing the goods or services invoiced on the sub invoice line.
notes: Identifier, name and cardinality are taken from the semantic model column of the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.

terms.name: SUB INVOICE LINE ALLOWANCES
terms.description: Group carrying an allowance that applies to the sub invoice line.
notes: Identifier, name and cardinality are taken from the semantic model column of the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.

terms.name: SUB INVOICE LINE CHARGES
terms.description: Group carrying a charge that applies to the sub invoice line.
notes: Identifier, name and cardinality are taken from the semantic model column of the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.

terms.name: SUB INVOICE LINE PERIOD
terms.description: Group giving the period the sub invoice line relates to.
notes: Identifier, name and cardinality are taken from the semantic model column of the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.
The bound UBL element has a different syntax cardinality than the semantic one.

terms.name: SUB INVOICE LINE VAT INFORMATION
terms.description: Group carrying the VAT information for the item on the sub invoice line.
notes: Identifier, name and cardinality are taken from the semantic model column of the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.

terms.name: SUB INVOICE LINE PRICE DETAILS
terms.description: Group carrying the price information for the item on the sub invoice line.
notes: Identifier, name and cardinality are taken from the semantic model column of the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.
The bound UBL element has a different syntax cardinality than the semantic one.

terms.name: SUB INVOICE LINE ITEM ATTRIBUTES
terms.description: Group carrying one additional attribute of the item on the sub invoice line.
notes: Identifier, name and cardinality are taken from the semantic model column of the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.

terms.name: THIRD PARTY PAYMENT
terms.description: Group carrying information about a third-party claim that is settled together with the invoice.
notes: Identifier, name and cardinality are taken from the semantic model column of the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.

terms.name: Third party payment type
notes: Identifier, name, cardinality and semantic data type are taken from the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.

terms.name: Third party payment amount
notes: Identifier, name, cardinality and semantic data type are taken from the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.
EN 16931-1, 6.5.12, Table 26 lists decimal limits for core business terms only, so no maxDecimals is recorded for this extension term.

terms.name: Third party payment description
terms.description: Description of the third-party claim, unique within the invoice.
notes: Identifier, name, cardinality and semantic data type are taken from the XRechnung 3.0.2 UBL syntax-binding extension, table 1.1.
